name: operationSearch
label: Find operations
help: Words that fill the Endpoint ID list, for example `verify an email`. Leave empty to list verified endpoints. Only used to fill the list; the module does not send it.

name: endpointId
label: Endpoint ID
help: Pick an endpoint, or type or map an endpoint ID from Search operations. A job (`job:<job id>`) is not one operation; search with Job ID set to it to list its endpoints.
